title: Ɔkra a Odi Kan a Ogyina hɔ
intro: Bere tenten ansa na ɔbɔfo biara renantew asase so, ansa na wɔreda kyerɛwsɛm biara adi no, abɔde bi a ɔnte sɛ foforo biara bae. Wɔde ɔsoro nsa na ɛhyehyɛɛ ɔkra yi, wɔmaa no beae a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛso bi nni, na wɔsɔɔ no hwɛe wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛka adesamma abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu. Nea edii akyi bae ne mmerɛwyɛ, adwensakra a efi komam, ne nkrabea a ɛbɛsakra adebɔ kwan koraa ho asɛm. So wubetumi asusuw onii ko a eyi yɛ ho?
clues: Mmɔborɔhunufoɔ no nsa na ɛnam mfuturo a ɛwɔ fam no mu ankasa na ɛhyehyɛɛ me
Wɔmaa me ofie a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛso bi nni, baabi a ɔkɔm anaa ɔbrɛ biara ntumi nka me
Wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ memmmɛn dua biako mpo da, efisɛ na wɔabara
Wɔdaadaa me ne me hokafoɔ no na yɛbɛn dua a wɔabara no, tiaa yɛn Awurade ahyɛdeɛ
Yɛsan de ahonu a ɛyɛ nokware san kɔɔ yɛn Awurade nkyɛn, na wɔde yɛn mmarato bɔne kyɛɛ yɛn
Yɛn mu na adesamma nyinaa fi bae; Me ne obi a odii kan nantew asase yi so

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Sɔhwɛ a ɛnam dua a wɔabara no so
Ɔba a ɔdɔ no no afɔrebɔ
Wɔtow no gu ogya kɛse mu
trial.answer: Sɔhwɛ a ɛnam dua a wɔabara no so

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔsomaa no baa asase so sɛ adesamma hwɛfo a odi kan
Farao ne n’asraafo no memee wɔ po no mu
Ogya no bɛyɛɛ nwini na asomdwoe wom
Wɔmaa no tumi wɔ Misraim ahemman no so
outcome.answer: Wɔsomaa no baa asase so sɛ adesamma hwɛfo a odi kan

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
